title: Generative Learning on Manifolds for Probabilistic Seismic Performance Assessment and Structural Identifiability
abstract: arXiv:2611.12908v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Seismic performance assessment relies on computationally expensive nonlinear simulations, limiting uncertainty quantification and inference of structural properties from observed responses. We develop a manifold-based generative framework that learns the joint distribution of uncertain structural parameters and seismic-response trajectories from limited high-fidelity simulations. Combining Diffusion Maps, score-based Diffusion Modeling, and Geometric Harmonics, the framework enables both forward probabilistic prediction and inverse inference. Applied to a nine-story steel moment-resisting frame, the results reveal which structural properties are identifiable from seismic performance and how uncertainty in these properties influences response. translated_title: 基于流形生成学习的概率地震性能评估与结构可辨识性
translated_abstract: 地震性能评估依赖于计算成本高昂的非线性仿真，这限制了不确定性量化以及从观测响应中推断结构特性的能力。我们开发了一种基于流形的生成框架，能够从有限的高保真仿真中学习不确定结构参数与地震响应轨迹的联合分布。该框架结合了扩散映射、基于分数的扩散建模和几何调和方法，可实现正向概率预测与反向推断。将该框架应用于一座九层钢抗弯框架，结果揭示了哪些结构特性可从地震性能中辨识出来，以及这些特性的不确定性如何影响结构响应。特别是，学习到的表示比单个强度参数更有效地捕捉了峰值后退化特性。反向推断可识别出不同的结构特性（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究提出一种结合扩散映射、分数扩散模型与几何调和的流形生成学习框架，可从有限的非线性仿真中学习结构参数与地震响应的联合分布，同时实现地震性能的正向概率预测与结构特性的反向辨识。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a manifold-based generative learning framework combining Diffusion Maps, score-based diffusion modeling, and Geometric Harmonics, which learns the joint distribution of structural parameters and seismic response trajectories from limited simulations, enabling both forward probabilistic seismic performance prediction and inverse identifiability of structural properties.
